narrative.overview: Centris combines modular dark bento surfaces (24px rounded cards, subtle 1px hairline borders, and pill-shaped metric containers) with clear Argentine Spanish terminology and role-aware navigation. Clean Inter typography in Sentence case replaces condensed uppercase headings, while Volt Lime (#C1F429), Mint Active (#18FFC8), and Coral Alert (#FF6D6D) signal action and status cleanly.
keyCharacteristics: Obsidian dark canvas (#09090B) with surface cards (#111214) and elevated nested wells (#18191C) separated by 1px #232428 borders.
Mockup-aligned palette: Volt Lime (#C1F429) primary accent with #000000 foreground, Mint Active (#18FFC8) positive status, Coral Alert (#FF6D6D) overdue/warning alerts.
Single clean sans-serif family (Inter in Light/Regular/Medium/SemiBold) using Sentence case and tabular-nums alignment.
Left vertical sidebar showing both icon and visible section label per role, paired with a contextual pill topbar.

rules.name: The Black-on-Volt Rule
rules.body: Never render white (#FFFFFF) text or icons on Volt Lime (#C1F429). Every Volt Lime surface uses Pure Black (#000000) foreground content.

rules.name: The Visible Sidebar Label Rule
rules.body: Desktop left sidebar items must always display both icon and visible section label so owners, receptionists, coaches, and athletes recognize routes immediately.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Apply .tabular-nums to every currency amount, time range, duration, capacity ratio, percentage, and credit counter.

rules.name: The 16px Input Floor Rule
rules.body: Interactive <input> and <select> controls stay at 16px (1rem) minimum on mobile viewports.

dos: Do pair Volt Lime (#C1F429) exclusively with Pure Black (#000000) text and icons.
Do use Inter in Sentence case across headings and card titles.
Do keep 24px corner radius on primary bento cards and 9999px on pills, chips, and circular quick-action buttons.
Do keep every interactive sidebar item, button, and input at 44px minimum touch height.
donts: Don't use Oswald or forced all-caps display headings.
Don't render icon-only desktop sidebar navigation without visible section labels.
Don't place white text on Volt Lime (#C1F429) or Mint Active (#18FFC8).
